name: Break the Deal

objectives.text: Stash a DVL-10 sniper rifle at the specified spot on Customs
Stash a DVL-10 magazine at the specified spot on Customs
Stash an ELCAN SpecterDR scope at the specified spot on Customs
Stash a pack of any 7.62x51 ammo at the specified spot on Customs

rewards: 1× IOTV Gen4 body armor (High Mobility Kit, MultiCam)
guide:
In this quest you have to stash the 4 specified items on the scaffolding of the southern industrial plant building on Customs. After accepting the quest you will be sent a set of the required items via in-game mail. It is possible to completely disassemble the DVL-10 rifle since it doesn't need to be functional to be stashed.
Note: If you have a DVL-10 equipped as primary or secondary weapon, it will be used up as first for the stashing.
